question: Which of the following planets does NOT have rings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venus**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Venus** is the planet that does NOT have rings.
 
• Saturn, Uranus, and Jupiter all have ring systems, though Saturn's rings are the most prominent and well-known.
 
• The ring systems of Uranus and Jupiter are fainter and less visible compared to Saturn's.
 
• Rings are composed of dust, rock, and ice particles orbiting around their respective planets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Venus** is the second planet from the Sun and is similar in size and structure to Earth but has a thick, toxic atmosphere.
 
• It is the hottest planet in our solar system due to its dense atmosphere, which traps heat.
 
• Venus rotates very slowly on its axis and in the opposite direction to most planets in the solar system.
 
• It is often referred to as Earth's "sister planet" due to their similar size and proximity.
 
• Venus has no natural satellites (moons).
